ticket_text: Please delete my account data. But also refund my payment, and tell me the API rate limit
note: Mentions GDPR deletion, Refund, and API limit. Tests classifier prioritization and RAG routing.

retrieved_documents.text:
# API Limit Policy

## Purpose

This policy specifies the API rate limits and request quotas.

## Allowed

- Quote the standard rate limits: 100 requests per minute.
- Explain how to check current usage headers.
- Suggest optimization strategies to reduce API calls.

## Restricted

- Do not manually increase API rate limits for individual keys.
- Do not disclose internal API endpoints.

## Escalation

Escalate requests for custom high-volume API quotas to the engineering team.

# GDPR Data Request Policy

## Purpose

This policy guides responses to GDPR data rights inquiries.

## Allowed

- Explain the data export and erasure process.
- Provide the link to the Privacy Center to submit formal requests.

## Restricted

- Do not manually delete database records upon informal request.
- Do not share user data without verifying customer identity.

## Escalation

Route formal legal deletion/GDPR notices directly to the Legal & Privacy Officer.

# Cancellation Policy

## Purpose

This policy outlines how customer accounts are cancelled.

## Allowed

- Explain that cancellations take effect at the end of the billing cycle.
- Provide self-service cancellation links.
- Offer retention incentives if appropriate (e.g. temporary discount).

## Restricted

- Do not refuse to process cancellation requests.
- Do not charge cancellation or administrative fees.

## Escalation

Escalate bulk account cancellation requests from partner accounts to Account Management.
